experiences.description: I lead product design across the product and its communication.
I built and led UX courses, workshops, UX Storm, and mentorship programs.
I founded artmart, a contemporary art school in Armenia.
I designed products with a large fintech team.
I designed the product and its design system for an international materials platform.
I led design systems and interface work for complex enterprise products.
I designed the product from its first MVP through early growth.
I designed mobile and web insurance products.
I designed mobile wallet and crypto-fintech products.
I designed interfaces for digital banking products.

headline: Learn design
through practice
and critique.
hero.lead: I teach beginners in Armenia to research problems, critique work, use modern tools, and build one product case they can defend.

school.note: Classes happen in person, with online support between sessions. Each group stays small so everyone gets direct critique.

standards.title: Thinking before screens
standards.copy: Students research the problem, ask useful questions, and explain each design choice.

standards.title: Critique as a habit
standards.copy: We review work in the room, challenge weak choices, and revise until the reasoning holds.

standards.title: Tools with taste
standards.copy: Figma and AI support the work. Judgment, structure, and visual clarity decide the result.

practice.copy: Students repeat the work, get direct critique, and finish with a case that explains the thinking behind each screen.
